message.quirky.totem_spawned: Your holding totem spawned in %s at (%s, %s, %s) — %s blocks from your spawn point
message.quirky.totem_spawned_cross: Your holding totem spawned in %s at (%s, %s, %s) — not in the same dimension as your spawn point
tooltip.quirky.rope:
Place against a wall or under a block; right-click a rope to extend, sneak for batch.
Climbable, slide safely (sneak to let go). Right-click with a lantern to hang it.
tooltip.quirky.seed_pouch: Right-click to plant; click in inventory to store seeds
tooltip.quirky.fish_bait: Throw into water to create a bait zone that makes nearby bobbers bite faster
text.autoconfig.quirky.title: Quirky Config
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.hitsToRetr: How many hits the holding totem needs before it drops its contents.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.spawnHeigh: How many blocks above the death point the holding totem spawns. 1 keeps it in reach; 2 raises it one block higher.
tooltip.quirky.quiver.usage: Left-click ammo to load · Right-click to take out · Bows auto-draw from quiver
tooltip.quirky.pet_whistle:
Right-click: pets within range path to you, farther ones teleport
Sneak+right-click: toggle sit/stand
At night: taunts phantoms to dive at you
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.heartbeatI: Copper golem autonomous action interval; 0 = disabled. Only fires when a player is nearby.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.aiApiKey.@: API key. Leave empty to keep copper golems fully vanilla.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.aiModel.@T: Model name (e.g. deepseek-chat, qwen-max). Required together with API key.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.aiListenRa: How many blocks away a golem hears you chat.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.maxTranspo: Max distance to containers for transport/collect/auto-return. Targets beyond it are rejected immediately; lower it if golems keep failing to reach far chests.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.golemAiEna: Master switch for golem AI (chat, heartbeat, tools). Off = golems stay fully vanilla. Requires an API key and model below.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.wakeUpEnab: Grants brief Slow Falling after sleeping; interrupted sleep grants a third.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.autoClimbE: Facing a ladder or vine moves you up or down automatically; flat look glides.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.soulLightE: Torches and candles on soul sand/soil burn with soul-blue flames.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.harvestRep: Right-click mature crops to harvest and replant instantly; melons and vines pickable.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.doubleDoor: Wooden doors open together as a double door; iron doors stay vanilla.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.quickEquip: Right-click in container screens to wear items or swap with equipped gear; offhand slots too.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.melonSeedS: Eating the last slice of melon spits out the seeds.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.tickerEnab: Show a slide-out prompt above the hotbar on item pickup, consumption and armor durability loss.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.arrowDingE: Arrows ring on hit — bells for mobs, clang for metal armor, silent on shield block.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.campfireSm: Dye, glowstone dust and gunpowder color or thicken campfire smoke.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.deathCamEn: Pull the camera back slowly before the death screen.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.shulkerPre: Hover a shulker box to see its contents (Shift for details).
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.mapPreview: Hover a filled map to see a live 71x71 preview (Shift for details).
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.clockToolt: Hover a clock to see the day count and time (Shift for details).
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.foodToolti: Show hunger, saturation and eating conditions with icons on food items.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.attributeT: Show attack, attack speed, armor and toughness icons on items.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.advancedTo: Long descriptions are hidden by default; hold Shift to show them.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.totemEnabl: Keep your inventory floating above the death point on death; hit the totem to retrieve it.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.aiMaxToken: Max reply length per call (cost control).
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.aiSummaryM: Smaller model used to compress chat history. Empty = use main model.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.enchantPar: 1 in N chance per tick to spawn a purple rune particle; higher values make particles rarer.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.endRodPart: 1 in N chance per tick to spawn a white light particle; higher values make particles rarer.
Horizontal spread radius (blocks) of the white light particles.
Vertical spread height (blocks) of the white light particles.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.particleXz: Horizontal spread radius (blocks) of the purple rune particles.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.particleYS: Vertical spread height (blocks) of the purple rune particles.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.hitSoundVo: Volume of the sound when the totem is hit. Values above 1 only extend the falloff distance; loudness is capped at 1.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.hitSoundPi: Pitch of the sound when the totem is hit.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.retrieveSo: Volume of the sound when the totem's contents are retrieved.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.modelScale: Display scale of the holding totem model.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.bobAmplitu: How far the totem floats up and down (blocks).
Floating period in ticks; higher values bob slower.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.spinPeriod: Rotation period in ticks; higher values spin slower.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.swayPeriod: Sway period in ticks; higher values sway slower.
